use default
use System.Globalization
use System.Text.NormalizationForm

use TRANSFORM = (string) -> string

plain_whitespace(text: string) -> string =>
    text
        |> map(letter =>
            if char.is_white_space(letter) then ' ' else letter fi)
        |> join("")

single_spaces(text: string) -> string is
    let kept = LIST[char]()

    for letter in text do
        let after_space = kept.count > 0 /\ kept[kept.count - 1] == ' '

        if letter != ' ' \/ !after_space then
            kept.add(letter)
        fi
    od

    let joined = kept |> join("")

    joined.trim()
si

folded_case(text: string) -> string => text.to_lower()

replaced_letters(text: string) -> string =>
    text
        .replace("\u00DF", "ss")
        .replace("\u017F", "s")
        .replace("\u0292", "s")

split_ligatures(text: string) -> string =>
    text
        .replace("\u0133", "ij")
        .replace("\u00E6", "ae")
        .replace("\u0153", "oe")
        .replace("\uFB01", "fi")
        .replace("\uFB02", "fl")

bare_letters(text: string) -> string =>
    text.normalize(NormalizationForm.FORM_D)
        |> filter(letter =>
            CharUnicodeInfo.get_unicode_category(letter) !=
                UnicodeCategory.NON_SPACING_MARK)
        |> join("")

without_leading_article(text: string) -> string =>
    if text.starts_with("the ") then text[4..<0] else text fi

let transforms =
    [plain_whitespace, single_spaces, folded_case, replaced_letters,
     split_ligatures, bare_letters, without_leading_article]

key(text: string) -> string =>
    transforms |> reduce(text, (running, step) => step(running))

runs(text: string) -> Pipe[string] is
    let held = LIST[char]()

    for letter in text do
        let broke =
            held.count > 0 /\
                char.is_digit(held[held.count - 1]) != char.is_digit(letter)

        if broke then
            yield held |> join("")

            held.clear()
        fi

        held.add(letter)
    od

    if held.count > 0 then
        yield held |> join("")
    fi
si

is_number(part: string) -> bool =>
    part.length > 0 /\ (part |> all(letter => char.is_digit(letter)))

without_leading_zeros(part: string) -> string =>
    let trimmed = part.trim_start('0') in
    if trimmed.length == 0 then "0" else trimmed fi

compare_parts(left: string, right: string) -> int =>
    if is_number(left) /\ is_number(right) then
        let a = without_leading_zeros(left) in
        let b = without_leading_zeros(right) in
        if a.length != b.length then
            a.length <> b.length
        else
            string.compare_ordinal(a, b)
        fi
    else
        string.compare_ordinal(left, right)
    fi

naturally(left: string, right: string) -> int is
    let first = runs(key(left)) |> collect()
    let second = runs(key(right)) |> collect()
    let shared = if first.count < second.count then first.count
                 else second.count fi

    for index in 0..shared do
        let outcome = compare_parts(first[index], second[index])

        if outcome != 0 then return outcome fi
    od

    first.count <> second.count
si

visible(text: string) -> string =>
    text
        .replace("\t", "\\t").replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "\\r")
        .replace("\u000B", "\\v").replace("\u000C", "\\f")

demonstrate(feature: string, samples: List[string]) is
    write_line("{feature}:")
    write_line("  given:")

    samples |> each(text => write_line("    \"{visible(text)}\""))

    write_line("  naturally:")

    samples
        |> sort(naturally)
        |> each(text => write_line("    \"{visible(text)}\""))

    write_line()
si

demonstrate("ignoring leading spaces",
    ["ignore leading spaces: 2-2", " ignore leading spaces: 2-1",
     "  ignore leading spaces: 2+0", "   ignore leading spaces: 2+1"])

demonstrate("ignoring multiple adjacent spaces",
    ["ignore m.a.s spaces: 2-2", "ignore m.a.s  spaces: 2-1",
     "ignore m.a.s   spaces: 2+0", "ignore m.a.s    spaces: 2+1"])

demonstrate("equivalent whitespace characters",
    ["Equiv. spaces: 3-3", "Equiv.\rspaces: 3-2", "Equiv.\u000Cspaces: 3-1",
     "Equiv.\u000Bspaces: 3+0", "Equiv.\nspaces: 3+1",
     "Equiv.\tspaces: 3+2"])

demonstrate("case independent",
    ["cASE INDEPENDENT: 3-2", "caSE INDEPENDENT: 3-1",
     "casE INDEPENDENT: 3+0", "case INDEPENDENT: 3+1"])

demonstrate("numeric fields as numbers",
    ["foo100bar99baz0.txt", "foo100bar10baz0.txt",
     "foo1000bar99baz10.txt", "foo1000bar99baz9.txt"])

demonstrate("title sorts",
    ["The Wind in the Willows", "The 40th step more", "The 39 steps",
     "Wanda"])

demonstrate("equivalent accented characters",
    ["Equiv. \u00FD accents: 2-2", "Equiv. \u00DD accents: 2-1",
     "Equiv. y accents: 2+0", "Equiv. Y accents: 2+1"])

demonstrate("separated ligatures",
    ["\u0132 ligatured ij", "no ligature"])

demonstrate("character replacements",
    ["Start with an \u0292: 2-2", "Start with an \u017F: 2-1",
     "Start with an \u00DF: 2+0", "Start with an s: 2+1"])
